_meta.rule: Every value carries src (key into sources), loc, and a short quote from the saved document. derived = arithmetic done here from sourced values. alternatives = other sourced values (conflicts).
_meta.quote_normalisation: Quotes are copied from pdftotext / HTML text; degree glyphs (◦) and double primes (rendered "00") normalised; OCR-layer quotes from ADS scans had obvious glyph errors fixed (e.g. "//15" -> "f/15") after checking page images for key values.

Collimator focal length: 4.1547 m (HM94 App. E) vs 4.176 m DERIVED from the 12-in beam x f/13.7 (V94); beam 0.3028 m (HM94 App. E) vs 12 in = 0.3048 m (V94).

XD blaze: "blazed at 7000 A (first-order)" (V94, design) vs as-made 4.3 deg with 1st-order peak near 0.56 um (HM94 text) vs "5 degree blaze angle" (HM94 Fig. 6 label).
Resolution at 0.861": 45,000 (HM94, Tek CCD) vs 48,000 calculated / 49,000-50,000 measured (Keck page, MIT-LL mosaic) -- different detectors.
notes: HIRES is permanently at the right Nasmyth focus of Keck I; slit plane tilted 7.5 deg for the guider (V94).
The HM94 manual (1994, Tek CCD era) is the only source with collimator/camera focal lengths; post-2004 numbers come from Keck web pages and the 2008 user notes.
Cross-disperser swap is a daytime operation: observers request HIRESb or HIRESr (KBVR).

longslit_lris.title: Keck I / LRIS red channel (long-slit grating spectrograph) -- chosen long-slit preset
longslit_lris.why_chosen: LRIS has a refereed instrument paper (O95) giving collimator focal length, camera focal length and f/#, collimated-beam diameter, the camera-collimator angle, telescope f/# and plate scale, detector pixel and on-sky scale, grating dispersions and a measured narrow-slit image width; Keck's current web pages add a full red-grating table (grooves/blaze wavelength, A/pix, coverage, FWHM for a 1" slit) and current detector specs. Palomar DBSP (OG82 + Palomar spec page) was the runner-up: comparable optics data but dispersions only in A/mm, no published resolution, and the red camera has since been replaced (152 mm in 1982 vs 12 in now).
longslit_lris.recommended_preset: Red side, 600/7500 grating, 1.0" long slit, current LBNL detector (15 um, 0.135"/pix): validate against 0.80 A/pix, 3275 A coverage, FWHM 4.7 A (1" slit). A 1995-era preset (Tek 2048^2, 24 um, 4.685 pix/") can be validated against O95 (600 g/mm: 2.55 A per 48 um).
